candidates.child_definition: A train whose designed function includes carrying persons who bear a rail passenger role.
A process in which a train travels along railway tracks from a departure railway station to an arrival railway station.
An information content entity that specifies a planned rail journey, including planned endpoints and timing, and is not itself a rail journey process.
A role borne by a person in virtue of being carried, or authorized to be carried, on a passenger train during a rail journey.
A role borne by a person in virtue of being carried, or authorized to be carried, on a passenger train during a rail journey.

An information content entity that is reservation information about a planned rail journey or related travel entitlement, distinct from any material booking artifact and from the rail journey process.
A material information bearer that is a ticket and bears information authorizing travel associated with a rail journey.
A material entity comprising physical railway facilities at which rail journeys begin, end, or pause, potentially including platforms, track infrastructure, structures, and buildings.
A material entity composed of one or more rail vehicles operated together on a railway to convey passengers or freight.

constraint: Ticket-as-bearer versus digital information remains a blocking human design review; source must remain unchanged.
scope: Assess subclass plausibility only. Do not infer real-world individuals, a person's intentions, or threat status.
